_comment: Component prefix = first digit of the component in paper_id.
qp_skip_pages: 0-indexed page indices to exclude when running page_segmenter on the QP.
ms_start_page: 1-indexed page where mark scheme content begins (used by VL parser).
MCQ papers don't use ms_start_page (block extraction scans all pages).
Structured paper QPs that include a data/formula page need an extra skip.
_default (per subject): applies to any component with no entry of its own.
Only list a numbered component when it differs from the subject's _default.
